messages:
From: Sam Park <sam@polybox.ai>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: support@polybox.ai
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quickstart credits request — PolyBox evaluation

Hi Markus,

We just completed a self-serve signup (PolyBox, sam@polybox.ai) and hit a usage limit while running a short proof-of-concept. We'd like to request a small credit grant so our team can finish a 2-week evaluation. High level:

- Use case: abstractive summarization pipeline for internal docs and meeting notes.
- Expected evaluation volume: ~150k tokens over two weeks.
- Data sensitivity: no customer PII in the test corpus (internal docs + meeting notes redacted).
- Goal: validate model quality and latency on 1–2 production routes before committing to dedicated capacity.

I attached a short snippet of recent usage and a one-page product brief for context. Can the team top up our account with 50k tokens or a short-term credit so we can complete the run? We're on the free-tier sign-up (self-serve).

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Sam Park
Head of Product, PolyBox AI
sam@polybox.ai
+1 (415) 555-0199

[Attachment: polybox_usage_sample.csv (text/csv)]
[Attachment: polybox_product_brief.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Sam Park <sam@polybox.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quickstart credits request — PolyBox evaluation

Hi Sam — thanks for the details and the brief. A couple quick clarifying questions so we can triage this fast:

1) Is the 150k token estimate total project usage or just the remaining run you need unlocked?
2) Do you anticipate any production traffic that will be tied to end-customer data during the evaluation? If so, which retention/KMS model would you plan to use?
3) Which model families are you testing (e.g., small/med/llama-like variants)? This helps us size cost.

I looped in Marissa (sales ops) and Ben (PLG support) to speed the approval. Our usual self-serve top-ups get approved quickly when the use-case is low-risk and the customer is likely to convert. If you prefer, we can issue a short-term account credit that auto-applies — speed is usually best.

Also, here is our self-serve credits policy for reference: https://docs.redwood.ai/self-serve-credits-policy

—Markus
Director, PLG Growth
Redwood Inference

Thanks Markus — quick answers inline: 

1) 150k is our total projection for the 2-week evaluation; we currently consumed ~95k and need roughly 55–60k more to finish the full run.
2) No end-customer PII will be included in this eval. All meeting transcripts are redacted and internal-only. We don't plan to connect live data during the trial.
3) We're testing two model families: a smaller low-latency variant for real-time recaps and a mid-sized model for higher-quality summaries (both open models listed in your catalog).

If it's easier, a 60k-token top-up (applied as account credit) would let us finish. If you need anything else (billing contact, expected conversion timeline), happy to share: we expect to decide on a paid plan within 30 days if quality/latency checks pass.

Sam
